name: h
description: Fixed Kie-only batch and single workflow with automatic first-use setup.

interface.shortDescription: Fixed Kie batch or single workflows with automatic setup.
interface.longDescription: H runs Kie-only workflows through one deterministic Chinese menu protocol with two modes: recursive whole-folder concurrent batch processing and one-model single processing. On first use it discovers the Codex runtime, creates a reusable private Python environment, scans and installs missing dependencies, validates Kie without submitting generation work, saves task IDs for safe resume, validates downloaded media, and writes Desktop text, image, and video folders on Windows and Intel or Apple Silicon macOS.
defaultPrompt: 使用 H 批量处理整个 PID 产品文件夹。
使用 H 单独调用一个 Kie 文本、图像或视频模型。
使用 H 继续已保存的 Kie 生成任务。
